title: `Core\Http::allowUrl` resolves, checks and pins: it answers a `Target` carrying the URL and every approved address, and the connection is made to one of them
divergesFromPhp: `file_get_contents($userUrl)` and `curl_setopt(CURLOPT_URL, $userUrl)` are a compile-time diagnostic, and the laundered value is a `Target` the program cannot read an address back out of, not a string
